stemMd: Suppose the additional condition is: Ada must be in position 1. Which further statement must then be true?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Ada and Dina must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Ada must not be in position 1.

explanationMd:
First restrict attention to orders satisfying the extra condition as well as the original rules. There are 2 such orders. "Ada and Dina must not occupy consecutive positions." holds throughout this restricted set; the other statements fail on the explicit examples in their feedback.

The remaining orders are:
- Ada → Bela → Dina → Ciro → Enzo
- Ada → Ciro → Enzo → Bela → Dina

distractorRationale.c: Even with the additional condition, Ada → Bela → Dina → Ciro → Enzo is permitted and makes this statement false.
